summary: Provides the core application logic by organizing modules responsible for directory concept construction, domain error handling, and package analysis and concept generation.
responsibilities: Manage directory concept construction and define build result data structures
Define domain-specific errors and phase classifications for error handling
Provide core logic for package analysis, concept generation, dependency collection, and path processing
relationships: The build module uses types defined in the types module to represent build outcomes.
ConceptError relates to ConceptPhase to classify errors during conceptual execution.
Package analysis and package concept generation utilize internal package utilities to support operations.
design_decisions: Organizes core logic into modular subdirectories covering directory concepts, error handling, and package analysis.
Defines domain-specific error classes alongside phase classifications for handling exceptions.
